# Erlebnis.Stadt Menden

> Smart City platform for discovering and experiencing the city of Menden

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-EUPL%201.2-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Built with Urbo Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with-Urbo%20Framework-green.svg)](https://gitlab.opencode.de/stadt-soest/city-app/soest-city-app)

## 📖 Overview

Erlebnis.Stadt is a digital platform designed to help citizens and visitors discover Menden's diverse experiences, offers, and hidden gems. The platform aggregates places and micro-experiences across the city, providing a unified, accessible access point to local culture, tourism, and leisure activities.

**Key Features:**
- 🗺️ Interactive map with experience discovery
- 🔍 Fast, typo-tolerant search with Meilisearch
- 📱 Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline mode
- 🎯 Personalized favorites and recommendations
- 📅 Event calendar and experience chains
- 🌐 Multi-language support (German, English)

Built on the **Urbo Smart City Framework**, this project is open source to enable reuse and adaptation by other municipalities.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

This is a **monorepo** project containing two main workspaces:

```
menden-erlebnis-stadt/
├── app/              # End-user mobile application (Ionic/Angular)
├── cms/              # Content Management System (Angular/PrimeNG)
├── backend/          # Business Logic and API (Kotlin/Spring Boot)
└──documents/        # Architecture docs, API specs, meeting notes
```

### Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| **Frontend (App)** | Angular, Ionic, Capacitor | Mobile-first PWA for citizens |
| **Frontend (CMS)** | Angular, PrimeNG, Tailwind CSS | Content management interface |
| **Backend** | Kotlin, Spring Boot| Business logic & API |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL| Persistent data storage |
| **Search** | Meilisearch | Full-text search engine |
| **Storage** | LocalStack S3 | Object storage for media |
| **Auth** | Keycloak | OAuth2/OIDC authentication |
| **Build System** | Nx, pnpm | Monorepo tooling |
| **Deployment** | Kubernetes, Helm, Docker | Container orchestration |
